en.subject: Welcome to {app_name}

ms.subject: Selamat datang ke {app_name}

zh.subject: 欢迎使用 {app_name}

ar.subject: مرحبًا بك في {app_name}

en.subject: Invoice {invoice_number} from {company_name}
en.body:
Dear {customer_name},

Please find attached invoice {invoice_number} for {invoice_total}, due on {due_date}.

You can view it online at {invoice_url}.

Thank you for your business,
{company_name}

ms.subject: Invois {invoice_number} daripada {company_name}
ms.body:
Yang dihormati {customer_name},

Bersama ini dilampirkan invois {invoice_number} berjumlah {invoice_total}, perlu dibayar pada {due_date}.

Anda boleh melihatnya dalam talian di {invoice_url}.

Terima kasih atas urusan anda,
{company_name}

zh.subject: 来自 {company_name} 的发票 {invoice_number}
zh.body:
尊敬的 {customer_name}：

附上发票 {invoice_number}，金额为 {invoice_total}，到期日为 {due_date}。

您可以在 {invoice_url} 在线查看。

感谢您的惠顾，
{company_name}

ar.subject: الفاتورة {invoice_number} من {company_name}
ar.body:
عزيزي {customer_name}،

مرفق الفاتورة {invoice_number} بمبلغ {invoice_total}، تستحق في {due_date}.

يمكنك عرضها عبر {invoice_url}.

شكرًا لتعاملكم معنا،
{company_name}

en.subject: Payment received – {payment_number}

ms.subject: Bayaran diterima – {payment_number}

zh.subject: 已收到付款 – {payment_number}

ar.subject: تم استلام الدفعة – {payment_number}

en.subject: Reminder: invoice {invoice_number} is due
en.body:
Dear {customer_name},

This is a friendly reminder that {balance_due} on invoice {invoice_number} was due on {due_date}. Please arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

If you have already paid, kindly ignore this message.

{company_name}

ms.subject: Peringatan: invois {invoice_number} perlu dibayar
ms.body:
Yang dihormati {customer_name},

Ini peringatan mesra bahawa {balance_due} bagi invois {invoice_number} perlu dibayar pada {due_date}. Sila jelaskan bayaran secepat mungkin.

Jika anda telah membayar, sila abaikan mesej ini.

{company_name}

zh.subject: 提醒：发票 {invoice_number} 已到期
zh.body:
尊敬的 {customer_name}：

温馨提醒，发票 {invoice_number} 的未付金额 {balance_due} 已于 {due_date} 到期，请尽快安排付款。

如您已付款，请忽略此邮件。

{company_name}

ar.subject: تذكير: الفاتورة {invoice_number} مستحقة
ar.body:
عزيزي {customer_name}،

نذكّرك بأن مبلغ {balance_due} على الفاتورة {invoice_number} كان مستحقًا في {due_date}. يُرجى ترتيب الدفع في أقرب وقت.

إذا كنت قد دفعت بالفعل، يُرجى تجاهل هذه الرسالة.

{company_name}

en.subject: Proposal {proposal_number} from {company_name}
en.body:
Dear {customer_name},

Please find our proposal {proposal_number} for {proposal_total}. You can review and accept it at {proposal_url}.

We look forward to working with you,
{company_name}

ms.subject: Cadangan {proposal_number} daripada {company_name}
ms.body:
Yang dihormati {customer_name},

Bersama ini cadangan kami {proposal_number} berjumlah {proposal_total}. Anda boleh menyemak dan menerimanya di {proposal_url}.

Kami berharap dapat bekerjasama dengan anda,
{company_name}

zh.subject: 来自 {company_name} 的报价 {proposal_number}
zh.body:
尊敬的 {customer_name}：

附上我们的报价 {proposal_number}，金额为 {proposal_total}。您可以在 {proposal_url} 查看并接受。

期待与您合作，
{company_name}

ar.subject: العرض {proposal_number} من {company_name}
ar.body:
عزيزي {customer_name}،

مرفق عرضنا {proposal_number} بمبلغ {proposal_total}. يمكنك مراجعته وقبوله عبر {proposal_url}.

نتطلع إلى العمل معك،
{company_name}
